Name: Never Leave Farm
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A farm designed to keep you at the farm with farming, foraging, fishing, mining and combat.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A fun farm map that allows you to gain experience in all areas. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][b] [/b]Required (of course it's needed)[/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url] used[/color] to get ocean, lake and river fish based on your location within the farm. Required
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27359]Buildings Included [/url]used to get mill and fishpond. Optional 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager [/url]used for forage, mining and monster spawns. Required
